pairs.summary: SMAD5 and TP53 motifs co-occur in the same accessible ~300 bp windows more often than expected after matching GC, accessibility and repeat content, in 9 of 14 profiles analysed (786-O clear-cell renal carcinoma; A549 lung adenocarcinoma; DLD-1 colorectal adenocarcinoma; HT-29 colorectal adenocarcinoma; ...). Median lift 2.15x, typical spacing ~35 bp between sites. In 4 profile(s) the enrichment is seen in both replicate halves and the motifs are distinguishable. Caution: overlapping sites — the signal may reflect one family/shared motif rather than two distinct factors. This is a sequence-level hypothesis to test (e.g. ChIP/CUT&RUN co-binding, motif mutagenesis), not a confirmed interaction.
